name: Saltash Tunnel
facts: Opened in 1988, the Saltash Tunnel stretches 410 metres and handles over 38,000 motorists daily, with a central reversible lane that shifts direction to accommodate holiday and rush‑hour traffic.

Designed by Mott, Hay and Anderson and built by Balfour Beatty, the tunnel boasts a 100‑year design life, yet early flooding revealed hidden water channels that cracked decorative cladding within months.
After Parliament scrutiny by MP Colin Breed, a £7.4 million Skanska renovation replaced the cracked lining and upgraded the electrical system, restoring the tunnel’s safety and appearance.
